  "content": "&#96;&#96;&#96;cpp\n// This implements the Ghidra algorithm that loops backwards through the conversation tree\n// until it finds a level with active choices, or reaches level 1\nbool DialogManager::handleGoBack(const byte *data, Common::Stack&lt;uint32&gt; &amp;positionStack, uint32 position, ConversationState &amp;state) {\n\tif (data[position] != CTRL_GO_BACK) {\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\n\tdebug(\"F0 Go Back hit at position %u, current level %d\", position, state.currentChoiceLevel);\n\n\t// Find and disable the FB marker that led us here (the choice we just exhausted)\n\tuint32 scanPos = position;\n\twhile (scanPos &gt; 0) {\n\t\tscanPos--;\n\t\tif (data[scanPos] == CTRL_DIALOGUE_MARKER_ONEOFF &amp;&amp; scanPos + 2 &lt; position) {\n\t\t\t// This is the FB marker for the choice we just came from\n\t\t\tif (data[scanPos + 1] == state.currentChoiceLevel &amp;&amp; data[scanPos + 2] != CTRL_DISABLED_CHOICE) {\n\t\t\t\tdebug(\"F0: Found and disabling FB at pos %u, level %d\", scanPos, state.currentChoiceLevel);\n\t\t\t\tChoiceOption choiceToDisable;\n\t\t\t\tchoiceToDisable.room = g_engine-&gt;_room-&gt;_currentRoomNumber;\n\t\t\t\tchoiceToDisable.dataOffset = scanPos;\n\t\t\t\tchoiceToDisable.choiceIndex = state.currentChoiceLevel;\n\t\t\t\tchoiceToDisable.shouldDisableOnSelect = true;\n\t\t\t\tg_engine-&gt;_room-&gt;addDisabledChoice(choiceToDisable);\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tbreak;\n\t\t}\n\t\tif (data[scanPos] == CTRL_END_BRANCH || data[scanPos] == CTRL_ALT_SPEAKER_ROOT) {\n\t\t\tbreak;\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Pop position stack - we're going back to parent level\n\tuint32 parentPos = positionStack.empty() ? 0 : positionStack.pop();\n\n\tif (parentPos == 0) {\n\t\tdebug(\"F0: No parent position on stack, ending conversation\");\n\t\treturn false;\n\t}\n\n\t// Go up one level\n\tstate.currentChoiceLevel--;\n\tstate.position = parentPos;\n\tdebug(\"F0: Moved back to level %d, position %u\", state.currentChoiceLevel, parentPos);\n\n\treturn true;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n",
